hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central America, bordering both the Caribbean Sea and the North Pacific Ocean, between Nicaragua and Panama || coastal plains separated by rugged mountains including over 100 volcanic cones, of which several are major active volcanoes || four volcanoes, two of them active, rise near the capital of San Jose in the center of the country; one of the volcanoes, Irazu, erupted destructively in 1963-65 || Resources: hydropower || Exports: medical instruments, integrated circuits, orthopedic appliances, bananas, tropical fruits (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: coastal plains separated by rugged mountains including over 100 volcanic cones, of which several are major active volcanoes || Central America, bordering both the Caribbean Sea and the North Pacific Ocean, between Nicaragua and Panama

climate.excerpt: tropical and subtropical; dry season (December to April); rainy season (May to November); cooler in highlands || occasional earthquakes, hurricanes along Atlantic coast; frequent flooding of lowlands at onset of rainy season and landslides; active volcanoes volcanism: Arenal (1,670 m) is the most active volcano in Costa Rica; a 1968 eruption destroyed the town of Tabacon; Irazu (3,432 m), situated just east of San Jose, has the potential to spew ash over the capital city, as it did between 1963 and 1965; other historically active volcanoes include Miravalles, Poas, Rincon de la Vieja, and Turrialba

economy.excerpt: trade-based upper middle-income economy; green economy leader, having reversed deforestation; investing in blue economy infrastructure; declining poverty until hard impacts of COVID-19; lingering inequality and growing government debts have prompted a liquidity crisis || Exports: medical instruments, integrated circuits, orthopedic appliances, bananas, tropical fruits (2023) || Industries: medical equipment, food processing, textiles and clothing, construction materials, fertilizer, plastic products
